verdict.rationale: Eqvista documents migration from other platforms, with support guides for Pulley and Carta. It also offers a Spreadsheet Import feature and a white-glove migration service run by a dedicated team, so the guided-import core of the story is covered. Missing for 10: any evidence of in-product validation of imported data, reconciliation against source documents, detail on how the spreadsheet import works, and independent hands-on corroboration of a migration.
